$comment: Single source of truth for the npm `overrides` blocks in /package.json and /ruflo/package.json (ADR-171). Edit HERE, then run `node scripts/sync-overrides.mjs`; CI fails on drift (`--check`). IMPORTANT SEMANTICS: npm honors overrides only in the ROOT package of an install, so these blocks protect DEVELOPMENT installs inside this repo (and inside ruflo/) only — they do NOTHING for `npx ruflo` / `npm install ruflo` consumers. Consumer-facing security floors must be real dependency-range bumps in the owning packages; entries that exist only because an upstream fix has not landed are listed in pendingUpstream.

pendingUpstream.@opentelemetry/*: agentdb declares the OTel SDK + auto-instrumentations as hard deps; floors here only shield dev installs until agentdb makes them optional/lazy (ADR-169 Phase 3)
pendingUpstream.ruvector: agentdb pins ruvector ^0.1.30; alignment to ^0.2.x tracked in ADR-169 Phase 2
